authorization: Author approved continuing the proposed minimal CPU replay in the current conversation on 2026-10-26.
question: How do the current one-HGT-plus-one-ModernBERT same-seed systems behave when the graph file budget is 4, 8, 16 or 32, under the original component-isolated OOF fusion protocol?

design.graph_inputs: Saved raw logit margins from the already completed budget-specific HGT runs; budget16 uses the three individual margin columns in the P4 prediction file, not its ensemble scores.
design.sequence_inputs: The same frozen ModernBERT raw logit margins for each seed at every graph budget; the sequence file selection and 512-token limit are unchanged.
design.changed_neural_training_factor_in_histor: Graph max_selected_files only; all non-file graph budgets and original neural training/selection protocols remain as specified in S9-C/S9-C32.
design.new_operation: Refit only a two-feature CPU fusion/calibration pipeline separately for each budget, seed and outer fold.
design.fold_source: Unchanged saved P4/P5 outer_fold values, attached by unique sample_id.
design.fitting_scope: Other four outer folds only, including StandardScaler and LR.
design.threshold_scope: Other four outer folds only, using fitted training scores as in the original S8-A implementation.
design.evaluation_scope: Held-out fold only; concatenate the five held-out predictions for each seed before computing package-level metrics.

threshold_policy.candidate_thresholds: Every distinct outer-training fitted probability, via numpy.unique; prediction is score >= threshold.

reference_gate.reference: Saved S8-A same_seed_pair OOF scores and predictions for seeds1001/1002/1003.
reference_gate.failure_action: Stop and investigate without generating new-budget performance results.

reporting.primary_question_metric: OOF F1, arithmetic mean across the three same-seed pairs.
reporting.dispersion: Sample standard deviation across the three runs, ddof=1; not a confidence interval.
reporting.aggregation: Compute each seed's metrics first, then average those metrics; do not average seed probabilities into an ensemble.
reporting.legacy_three_HGT_budget_results: Historical reference only; not used as inputs, not relabeled as dual-branch outputs, and their uncertainty intervals are not transferred.
